# Standards & federation

Learniq declares the standards below in its manifest. OpenRegister publishes them to other servers without login, under `learniq.discovery` in `/ocs/v2.php/cloud/capabilities`, so another instance can tell from a hostname alone whether it can connect. Tools such as [Nextcloud Peek](https://genhttp.dev/lambda/nextcloud-peek/) show it too.

## Standards this app provides

| Standard | Version | Access | Endpoint |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Open Badges](https://www.imsglobal.org/spec/ob/v3p0) | 3.0 | Public | `/apps/learniq/api/credentials` |
| [W3C Verifiable Credentials Data Model](https://www.w3.org/TR/vc-data-model/) | 1.1 | Public | `/apps/learniq/api/credentials` |
| European Learning Model (Europass digital credentials) | 3.2 | Public | `/apps/learniq/api/credentials` |
| [xAPI Learning Record Store](https://github.com/adlnet/xAPI-Spec) | 1.0.3 | Token, no login | `/apps/learniq/api/lrs` |
| [cmi5 launch (LMS side)](https://github.com/AICC/CMI-5_Spec_Current) | — | Token, no login | `/apps/learniq/api/cmi5` |
| QTI item packages (import 2.1 and 3.0, export 3.0) | 3.0 | Nextcloud login | — |
| IMS Common Cartridge course packages (import and export) | 1.3 | Nextcloud login | — |

## Standards this app uses

None.

## Federation (Open Cloud Mesh)

Learniq registers no Open Cloud Mesh resource type of its own. Objects it stores in OpenRegister can still be shared with another instance through OpenRegister's `openregister` resource type.

## How another server finds this

```bash
curl -s -H 'OCS-APIRequest: true' \
  'https://cloud.example.org/ocs/v2.php/cloud/capabilities?format=json' \
  | jq '.ocs.data.capabilities["learniq"].discovery'
```

Paths are relative to the instance root. Prefix `/index.php` when the instance runs without pretty URLs (`core.mod-rewrite-working` is false). Endpoints that need a Nextcloud login are listed without their path.

## Administrators

- Stop publishing discovery for every app: `occ config:app:set openregister discovery_public --value=no`
- Hide only this app: add `learniq` to `occ config:app:set openregister discovery_hidden_apps --value=...` (comma separated)

Field reference and the shared list of standard ids: [Discovery and federation](https://github.com/ConductionNL/openregister/blob/development/docs/Technical/discovery-and-federation.md).
